WITH genre_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        i.billing_country,
        g.genre_id,
        g.name AS genre_name,
        SUM(ii.unit_price * ii.quantity) AS revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.billing_country ORDER BY SUM(ii.unit_price * ii.quantity) DESC) AS rn
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON i.invoice_id = ii.invoice_id
    JOIN tracks t ON ii.track_id = t.track_id
    JOIN genres g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id
    GROUP BY i.billing_country, g.genre_id, g.name
)

    genre_id,
    genre_name,
    revenue
FROM genre_revenue
WHERE rn = 1
